notes.title: Version 2.00: Nightmare mode and Steam Deck support
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38456139/53f5f9457dcf552c8fa516c4266ca987fbc2344b.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

We're back with a major update, bringing better compatibility for Steam Deck, a couple of quality of life features, adjusting some game balance issues. Plus, we're raising the level cap and adding two new difficulty levels!

Fixes for Steam Deck
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug related to frame rate.
[*] Adjustment of behavior when connecting an external controller
[/list]

Adjustment of some UI
[list]
[*] Added a function for bulk sales in the store.
[*] Added description to the special move detail screen.
[/list]

Adjustment of game balance
[list]
[*] Level cap changed from 50 to 100
[*] Added "Nightmare" and "Nightmare+" difficulty levels.
[*] Weapons with "Multi-Jump", "Dash in the air", and "Dash Attack" skills were added from the beginning.
[*] Drop rate of items has been revised upward.
[*] Lowered the number of times to raise the level of ultimate moves.
[*] Lowered the conditions for obtaining some achievements.
[/list]

With this update, you'll have tons of new challenges to face, whether at home, or on the go with the Steam Deck!


[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/38456139/1e402da7f8d204df2930342cf8619bca9ed13f6c.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.03 update
notes.content:
We apologize for keeping silent for such a long time. 
As promised, we are still working on making the game better over time. but due to the development schedule, some of the promised fixes still haven't been able to implement in the game yet. 

Before we can fully patch those fixes, we would like to provide additional language supports for more users to be able to experience the game.

[h3]Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed some minor issues with the new config feature.
[*]Added Traditional/Simplified Chinese support.

As always, we want to thank all the fans once again for their bug reports and feedback on the Steam Community forums. We will try our best to make Ogre Tale more accessible for every single user. Really appreciate your patience and support along the way.

Please keep warm and safe, and hope you have a great holiday!

notes.title: v1.02 update
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience, everyone! Another bugfix patch has gone in featuring more quality-of-life updates.

[h3]These include:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage displayed on the screen is 10x the damage being calculated internally (bigger numbers are more exciting, after all!). But previously, the total damage calculation reported was not properly reflecting this. This has now been fixed so that all damage reported displays the correctly inflated statistics.
[*]The achievement that was previously set to unlock when your cumulative damage total hit 8 million has now been reduced to 4 million to help curb unnecessary grinding.
 [*]The much-requested ability to exit the game from within its main menu has now been added -- it's the fourth selection under HELP & OPTION.
 [*]Key config has been added for keyboard users.
[/list]
A number of other bugfixes and tweaks have been implemented as well, mostly in response to player feedback -- so thank you, everyone who reported issues! You really helped make a difference, bringing numerous extremely specific issues to light so that we could make this game a little bit better.

[h3] Additional changes due to the inclusion of key config:[/h3]

Before this update, 2 players could play on a single keyboard, with player 1 using W A S D B J G H T Y U I 2 1 and player 2 using ↑ ← ↓ → L + 9 0 1 2.

This is no longer possible, as one keyboard is now regarded as a single control device, associated with only one single player (and there is no support for multiple keyboards at one time).

Control devices are auto-assigned to players, with controllers receiving preference over the keyboard as follows:
[list]
[*]No controller connected - keyboard is assigned to player 1
[*]1 controller connected - keyboard is assigned to player 2
[*]2 controllers connected - keyboard is assigned to player 3
[*]3 controllers connected - keyboard is not used
[/list]
Additionally, if a controller is removed during play, the control settings should automatically update to the appropriate state as noted above.

Finally, though not an update to the game itself, we wanted to also note that alongside this patch, [h3]Steam trading cards for Ogre Tale are also now available![/h3]

We want to thank all the fans once again for their bug reports and feedback on the Steam Community forums, and urge you to please keep them coming! We're still working with the developers to fix as many issues as we can, and really appreciate your patience and support along the way.

[h3]Our focus moving forward will be as follows:[/h3]

Planned for completion by the end of November:
[list]
[*]Addition of Chinese support (both traditional and simplified).
[/list]
Planned for completion by the end of the year:
[list]
[*]Tweaks to game difficulty per player feedback.
[*]Improvements to the shop UI.
[*]Fixes and tweaks to various enemy encounters.
[*]Increasing the scope and functionality of gameplay through the addition of story elements, difficulty adjustments, new uses for money, etc.
[/list]
[h2]Thank you again, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time with the game![/h2]

notes.title: v1.01 update
notes.content:
Pushed a bugfix patch featuring a variety of quality-of-life updates. These include:
[list]
[*][b]Windows 7 support added.[/b] The game's back end has been adjusted to use lower system requirements, so Windows 7 users should now be able to play without any difficulty.
[*]Bug fix: Continuing a mission in certain areas results in your playable character not appearing and the screen shaking, forcing you to quit the mission and restart it from the beginning. This should no longer occur, except in cases where game progress is saved with one or more missions in such a state. In these situations, you will need to restart the mission from the beginning simply to get around the saved bug state, but you should not encounter the problem again in the future.
[*]Bug fix: Issues with Kerberos boss seizing up and halting progression, forcing players to exit the mission. This should no longer occur.
[*]Bug fix: Rare issue where defeating the final enemy in a combat scene with Yume's bombs could cause a progress-halting issue, sometimes accompanied by Yume's bombs changing into character clones or other visual oddities. The exact trigger conditions for this are hard to reproduce, so it's difficult to fully test that the issue has been fixed, but the underlying cause of it has been addressed, so this should no longer occur.
[*]Corrections to the translation for numerous ultimate attacks. To anyone who was having issues leveling-up their ultimate attacks, this was likely the cause. Please check the conditions for leveling them once more, and you should no longer be presented with any incorrect information.
[*]Text re-formatting for better use of window space.
[*]Addition of "Exit" option on title screen.
[*]Disabling of Esc-key functionality during transitions and character select.
[*]Fix for window re-focusing when quitting to title screen.
[*]Addition of game icon on task bar.
[/list]

We want to thank all the fans for their bug reports and feedback on the Steam Community forums, and urge you to please keep them coming! We're working with the developers now to fix many of the other issues that have been reported, so please do expect further updates in the near future as well.

Our current focus is in the following areas:
[list]
[*]Additional bug fixes, in response to issues reported by players.
[*]Shoring up legacy Windows support.
[*]Chinese-language support.
[/list]

Thank you for your patience, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time with the game!
